items.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Joe Williams was born Joseph Goreed in 1918

ctx.x: Joe Williams was born Joseph Goreed in 1918 in Cordele, Georgia. At the age of three, his family relocated to Chicago, where he spent his formative years.

He has been a professional jazz singer since 1937 and had worked with Coleman Hawkins, Lionel Hampton, Andy Kirk and Red Saunders before joining the Count Basie band in 1954. His contribution to that ensemble “elevated the entire band to a new plateau of commercial success,” according to jazz critic Leonard Feather. Since becoming a solo singer in 1961, he has been equally successful at a time when rock threatened to swamp the world of jazz music.
